guidance.statement: Mid-single-digit value growth targeted for full FY26
guidance.quote: We are looking at mid-single-digit value growth for the full year

guidance.statement: Volume growth to outpace value by 4-5% in H2 FY26
guidance.quote: gap between the volume and the value would remain in that zone of about 4-5%

guidance.statement: Maintain 18-20% PBDIT margin guidance band going forward
guidance.quote: good to maintain the whole guidance of 18 to 20% PBDIT margin band

guidance.statement: Raw material prices expected to remain benign; monitor geopolitical risks
guidance.quote: raw material prices will remain benign as we see

guidance.statement: VAM VAE project committed CAPEX Rs. 3,250 crores; unfolds Q1 FY27
guidance.quote: committed to the project a CAPEX of about Rs. 3,250 crores

delivered.statement: Q2 FY26: 10.9% volume growth; H1 FY26: 7.2% volume growth
Q2 FY26: 6% value growth; H1 FY26: 2.1% value growth
Q2 gross margin 43.7%, expanded 270 bps year-over-year
Q2 PBDIT grew 21%; margin 18.5% (+230 bps QoQ)
9.9% growth INR terms; 10.6% constant currency growth
Revenue grew 13% Q2 FY26; PBT margins 17.3% (+160 bps)
New products now contribute more than 15% of revenue
Commissioned Fujairah UAE facility; tested to approximately 90% capacity
73 Beautiful Homes stores operational; number one integrated home decor player

themes: Regionalization with micro-market execution and culturally-appealing product packaging
Premium/luxury segment elevation through brand saliency and consumer upgradation
B2B expansion beyond builders/CHS into government and factory segments
Service economy expansion (warranties, waterproofing, beautiful home, metacare)
Backward integration investments (white cement plant, VAM VAE project)
Volume-value mix discipline across full consumer pyramid economy-to-luxury
risks: Industry demand weak at 3.5-4% growth; extended monsoons and short festive window
Home decor Kitchen/Bath segments showing year-over-year revenue decline despite initiatives
Geopolitical uncertainty could cause raw material price volatility and margin impact
Competitive intensity from new entrants using free grammage and discounting tactics

analyst_pushback.response: Nothing new; strategy reduces retailer turnover. Focus fundamentals, execution, brand building.
analyst_pushback.quote: work on fundamentals, our work on execution, our work on brand building will continue

analyst_pushback.topic: Internal factors vs macro demand as volume driver
analyst_pushback.response: Internal initiatives (media, execution, regionalization) primary; September-October saw demand pickup
analyst_pushback.quote: we were very clear that we need to really shift our gear to galvanize the market

analyst_pushback.response: Holistic approach across all segments essential; economy/mid-level segments are large
analyst_pushback.quote: this kind of volume-value gap will persist if we are looking at a far more holistic approach

analyst_pushback.response: Economy segment largest; new entrants paradoxically target economy despite premium positioning
analyst_pushback.quote: economy segment will still be the largest segment in terms of the market

tone_evidence: Strong execution narrative yielding double-digit volumes and margin expansion; cautious on weak 3.5-4% industry demand growth
